summary: For source plugins like `redhat.insights_eda`, add safe plugins to EDA: create `./group_vars/automationedacontroller/custom.yml` with `automationedacontroller_additional_settings: SAFE_PLUGINS: [ansible.eda.webhook, ansible.eda.alertmanager]`, which extends the EDA `settings.yaml` template.
questions: How do I add SAFE_PLUGINS to Event-Driven Ansible?
How do I extend EDA settings.yaml from the installer?

answer_card.title: Add safe plugins to EDA (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
mkdir -p ./group_vars/automationedacontroller
```
```yaml
# ./group_vars/automationedacontroller/custom.yml
automationedacontroller_additional_settings:
  SAFE_PLUGINS:
    - ansible.eda.webhook
    - ansible.eda.alertmanager
```
Then rerun the installer.
